note:
OPD follow-up. 58M, known T2DM x 6 yrs, HTN. C/o tingling in feet. No chest pain, no breathlessness.
Vitals: BP 148/92, PR 84/min, Wt 86 kg.
Labs: HbA1c 8.4%, FBS 162 mg/dL.
Plan: Increase metformin to 1000 mg BD. Continue telmisartan 40 mg OD. Add atorvastatin 10 mg HS.
Review after 3 months with HbA1c.

Pt is a 34 y/o F presenting with burning epigastric pain after meals x 2 wks, worse at night. Denies vomiting, melena or weight loss. No h/o NSAID use.
O/E: afebrile, BP 118/76, HR 72. Abdomen soft, mild epigastric tenderness.
Imp: GERD.
Rx: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast x 4 weeks. Avoid late meals.
F/u 4 weeks.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Admitted 12/10 with acute decompensated heart failure. Background: CAD s/p PCI 2019, CKD stage 3, T2DM.
Treated with IV furosemide, diuresed 4 L. Echo EF 30%.
Discharge vitals: BP 112/70, HR 78, SpO2 96% RA, weight 71.2 kg.
Creatinine 1.9, eGFR 38.
Discharge meds: Furosemide 40 mg BD (new), metoprolol 25 mg BD (continue), aspirin 75 mg OD (continue), atorvastatin 40 mg HS (continue). Metformin STOPPED due to renal function. Start insulin glargine 10 units at bedtime.
Follow up in cardiology clinic in 1 week.

Teleconsult. 45F, f/u of asthma. Using salbutamol inhaler 2-3 times/week. No nocturnal symptoms. No fever, no cough. Home peak flow not available.
Asthma partly controlled -> add budesonide/formoterol inhaler 200/6 one puff BD. Continue salbutamol PRN.
Allergic rhinitis - not present.
Review 6 weeks.

Annual health check, 29M, software engineer. No complaints. Non-smoker, occasional alcohol.
BP 124/80, pulse 70, height 176 cm, weight 79 kg, BMI 25.5.
Lipid profile: TC 212, LDL 141, HDL 42, TG 180 mg/dL.
Advised diet and exercise. No medications started. Repeat lipids in 6 months.

62 F, HTN, hypothyroid. BP today 162/98 despite Amlong 5 OD. Pt admits missing doses.
Plan: Amlong increased to 10 mg OD. Added Telma 40 mg OD. Thyronorm 50 mcg OD continue.
Sr. creatinine 0.9. Recheck BP in 2 weeks.

ED NOTE: 70M brought with fever, productive cough and breathlessness x 3 days. Smoker 40 pack-years, COPD.
T 101.8 F, HR 112, RR 26, BP 100/64, SpO2 88% on room air.
CXR: right lower lobe consolidation. WBC 16,000.
Dx: Community acquired pneumonia with COPD exacerbation.
Started IV ceftriaxone 1 g OD and azithromycin 500 mg OD, nebulised salbutamol. Admit to medicine ward.

Diabetic clinic. 51F, T2DM on Glycomet 500 BD and glimepiride 1 mg OD. Fasting sugar 7.8 mmol/L, A1c 7.6. Wt 74kg.
c/o recurrent hypoglycaemia in the afternoons -> glimepiride reduced to 0.5 mg OD. Metformin unchanged.
No retinopathy on fundus exam.
Next visit 3 months.

Pt seen for knee pain. 66F with bilateral knee OA, BMI 31.
Pain worse on climbing stairs. No swelling, no redness, no locking.
Paracetamol 650 mg TDS PRN. Physiotherapy referral. Weight reduction advised.
Avoid NSAIDs given CKD.
Return in 1 month.

Follow-up post MI. 55M, NSTEMI 2 months ago, PCI to LAD. Now asymptomatic, no angina, no dyspnoea.
BP 126/78, HR 64. LDL 88 on atorvastatin 80.
Continue aspirin 75 OD, clopidogrel 75 OD, atorvastatin 80 mg HS, metoprolol 50 mg BD.
Stop pantoprazole (no GI symptoms). Cardiac rehab ongoing. Review 3 months.

24F with burning micturition and frequency x 2 days. No fever, no flank pain. Urine dipstick nitrite positive.
Dx: uncomplicated cystitis (UTI).
Nitrofurantoin 100 mg BD x 5 days. Plenty of fluids. Return if fever.

Review of depression. 38M on sertraline 50 mg OD for 8 weeks, mood improved, sleep better. PHQ-9 down from 18 to 9. No suicidal ideation.
Increase sertraline to 100 mg OD for further response. Continue CBT. Review in 4 weeks.

CKD clinic. 72M, CKD 4 due to diabetic nephropathy, HTN. Cr 3.1, eGFR 19, Hb 9.2 g/dL. BP 150/88.
Start erythropoietin 4000 units SC weekly. Amlodipine increased from 5 to 10 mg. Continue linagliptin 5 mg OD.
Discussed RRT options. Next review 1 month.

Fever clinic. 19M, fever 3 days with headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain. No bleeding. NS1 positive.
T 38.9 C, BP 110/70, HR 98. Platelets 1.1 lakh.
Dx: dengue fever without warning signs.
Paracetamol 500 mg QID, oral fluids. Avoid aspirin/ibuprofen. Daily CBC. Review tomorrow.

Wt 198 lbs, Ht 5'7". BP 138/88. 47F here to discuss weight. Obesity class I, prediabetes (A1c 6.1). Snores, ?OSA - sleep study ordered.
Start metformin 500 mg OD with dinner. Lifestyle counselling. Review in 3 months.

60M ex-smoker, ?asthma vs COPD. Spirometry FEV1/FVC 0.62 post-BD -> COPD confirmed. SpO2 95%.
Start tiotropium 18 mcg OD. Salbutamol inhaler PRN. Pneumococcal and influenza vaccination given.
Smoking cessation maintained. Review 2 months.

S: 67 yo male w/ hx of HTN, hyperlipidemia here for routine visit. Reports good adherence. Occasional dizziness on standing.
O: BP 132/80 sitting, 118/72 standing. HR 68. Wt 77.5 kg.
A/P: HTN controlled, mild orthostasis - reduce amlodipine from 10 to 5 mg daily. Rosuvastatin 10 mg nightly - continue.
RTC 3 mo.

Pt c/o chest tightness on exertion since 1 month, relieved by rest. Known diabetic (on insulin). TMT: ST depression V4-V6.
Impression: chronic stable angina.
Started isosorbide mononitrate 30 mg OD, aspirin 75 mg OD and atorvastatin 40 mg at bedtime. Continue insulin.
Cardiology referral for angiography.

Discharge note - 81F admitted with fall at home, # neck of femur (R). Underwent hemiarthroplasty. Post-op Hb 8.4, transfused 1 unit PRBC. Background dementia, AF on apixaban.
Discharge to rehab facility. Meds: apixaban 2.5 mg BD (resume), paracetamol 1 g QID, calcium + vitamin D daily (new), alendronate 70 mg weekly (new). Stop zolpidem (falls risk).
Ortho review in 2 weeks for suture removal.

Telemedicine f/u. BP log at home avg 128/82. Pt reports dry cough since starting enalapril last month.
Plan: switch enalapril -> losartan 50 mg once a day.
F/U 1 mo w/ BP log.

New pt. 52F, recently diagnosed hypothyroidism elsewhere, TSH 11.2. Also c/o fatigue. No goitre. Not on any meds currently.
Start levothyroxine 50 mcg empty stomach daily. Repeat TSH in 6 weeks.
BP 120/78, pulse 62, wt 68 kg.

30M, acute gastroenteritis, 6 loose stools/day x 2d, no blood. Mild dehydration. Temp 37.9 C.
ORS. Ondansetron 4 mg SOS for vomiting. Probiotic. No antibiotics indicated.
Review if not better in 48 hrs.

Gout flare R big toe, 2nd episode this yr. Uric acid 8.9. Known HTN on hydrochlorothiazide.
Colchicine 0.5 mg BD x 5 days. Stop HCTZ, start amlodipine 5 mg OD instead. Start febuxostat 40 mg OD after flare settles (in 2 wks).
f/u 2 weeks

Follow-up of type 1 DM, 22F on basal bolus. Glargine 18 U at night, aspart with meals per carb counting. A1c 9.1% - suboptimal. Frequent missed doses at college.
Increase glargine to 20 units HS. Referred to diabetes educator. Weight 58 kg.
Next visit 6 weeks.

Pt presents w/ sudden onset R sided weakness and slurred speech, onset 2 hrs ago. BP 186/104. RBS 142. CT head: no bleed.
Dx: acute ischaemic stroke. Thrombolysed with alteplase. Admit stroke unit. Background: HTN (non-compliant), smoker.
Hold antihypertensives for now.

58M review. COPD GOLD 3 with 2 exacerbations this year. On tiotropium. SpO2 91% RA at rest.
Add inhaled fluticasone/salmeterol 250/50 BD. Continue tiotropium 18 mcg daily. Refer pulmonary rehab. Home O2 assessment.
Review 4 wks.

Daughter brings 72 yo with increased confusion x 3 days, poor oral intake. Na 124. Urine culture pending. Background: Parkinson's on levodopa-carbidopa 100/25 TDS; T2DM on metformin.
Imp: hyponatraemia, ?UTI. Admit, IV NS, hold metformin. Continue levodopa-carbidopa.
Wellness visit 41F. Fam hx of breast cancer. Pap and mammogram ordered. BP 112/74, BMI 22.4, HR 76. Fasting glucose 92 mg/dl, total cholesterol 186. No active issues. Continue OCP. Annual review.

Post-discharge f/u, HF. Weight up 2.5 kg in a week (now 74 kg), ankle oedema +. BP 104/66, HR 88. SpO2 94%.
Furosemide increased from 40 mg OD to 40 mg BD. Spironolactone 25 mg OD started. K+ and creatinine in 1 week.
Daily weights. Review 1 week.

Psoriasis plaques on elbows/knees, ~5% BSA. No joint pains. Topical clobetasol 0.05% cream BD x 2 wks then taper. Emollients.
Rv 1 month.

BP 170/100 on two occasions at chemist. Pt 49M asymptomatic, no headache, no chest pain. Clinic BP 164/102, pulse 80. Urine protein negative, creatinine 1.0. ECG LVH.
Dx: stage 2 hypertension. Start telmisartan 40 mg + amlodipine 5 mg (combination tab) once daily. Low salt diet.
Review 2 weeks.

35F with migraine without aura, 4-5 attacks/month. Using sumatriptan 50 mg PRN with relief.
Start propranolol 20 mg BD for prophylaxis. Headache diary. Review 2 months.

Hepatology OPD. 44M alcohol related liver disease, compensated cirrhosis. Abstinent 3 months. Platelets 98k, albumin 3.4.
Start propranolol 40 mg BD for varices (grade II on endoscopy). Thiamine 100 mg OD continue. USG + AFP every 6 months.
Next visit 3 months.

Rheum f/u RA. 50F on methotrexate 15 mg weekly + folic acid 5 mg weekly. DAS28 4.1 (moderate). LFTs normal.
Increase MTX to 20 mg once weekly. Add hydroxychloroquine 200 mg BD. Continue folic acid.
F/U 6 weeks with CBC, LFT.

Night call: 63M, POD2 after lap chole, c/o palpitations. HR 142 irregular, BP 126/80, SpO2 97%. ECG new onset AF with RVR. Electrolytes normal.
Given metoprolol 5 mg IV, then started metoprolol 25 mg PO BD. Anticoagulation decision deferred to cardiology in AM.

BP: 142/90  HR: 76  Temp: 98.4 F  Wt: 92 kg  SpO2: 98%
HPI: 56F with T2DM and HTN, here with lab results. HbA1c 7.2 (was 8.0). LDL 132. eGFR 64.
Assessment: diabetes improving; dyslipidaemia not at target.
Plan: Continue metformin 1 g BD and sitagliptin 100 mg OD. Start rosuvastatin 10 mg at night. Telmisartan 40 -> 80 mg daily.
Return 3 months.

Mrs K, 64, came in today. Her sugars have been running high (fasting 190s at home) so I've bumped up her Glycomet to 1g twice a day. BP was one hundred and forty over ninety. Weight 65 kgs. Otherwise feels ok. Recheck in a fortnight.
Pt known case of BPH on tamsulosin 0.4mg HS, c/o increased nocturia. PSA 2.1. Added finasteride 5 mg daily. Also iron deficiency anaemia - ferrous sulphate 200 mg BD started. Hb 10.1. F/U in 6 wks
Diabetic neuropathy pain++ in both feet, burning at night. On metfromin and glimipiride. Start pregabalin 75 mg at bedtime. HbA1c 8.9. Review 1 month.
Patient bata rahi hai ki BP ghar pe 150/95 aa raha tha. Clinic BP 156/96. Pehle se HTN hai, Telma 40 le rahi hai. Telma 80 kar diya. 2 hafte baad aana.

CC: SOB. 77 y/o w/ hx CHF (EF 25%), A-fib on warfarin. Wt gain 3 kg. Crackles bilat. Temp 99.1. O2 sat 92% on RA. INR 2.4. BNP 1800. Plan: Lasix 40 IV now then 40 PO BID, cont warfarin, hold amlodipine. Recheck BMP tmrw.

Seen in TB clinic. Sputum AFB positive, started on ATT - HRZE (isoniazid 300, rifampicin 600, pyrazinamide 1500, ethambutol 1200 mg) daily. Pyridoxine 10 mg OD. LFT baseline normal. Wt 52kg. Review 2 weeks.

Called pt with results. Potassium low at 3.1 — likely from the diuretic. Start potassium chloride 600mg twice daily x 1 week. Vitamin B12 also low at 150; start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Will recheck labs in 1 week.

56 M smoker, presents with cough x 3 weeks, wt loss 4kg. CXR R hilar mass. Suspect lung malignancy - CT chest + bronchoscopy. Not TB (GeneXpert negative). SpO2 96. Wt 61 kg. Review with reports in 5 days.
Follow up: Asthma well controlled on Foracort 200 two puffs twice a day. No night symptoms. Step down to Foracort 100. Montelukast stopped. Peak flow 420. Next review in three months.
Antenatal visit, 28 wks, G2P1. BP 142/94 — new. Urine protein 1+. ?pre-eclampsia, sent for labs. Start labetalol 100 mg BD. Continue iron and calcium. Fetal heart 144. Review in 3 days.

Discharge summary (abridged): Admitted with DKA, resolved with IV insulin + fluids. New dx T1DM, age 17. Discharged on insulin glargine 14 units at night and insulin lispro 4 units before meals. Diabetes educator seen. HbA1c 12.4. Endocrine clinic in 10 days.
Pt doing well post knee replacement 6 wks ago. Wound healed. Stopped enoxaparin. Continue paracetamol 1 g as needed and physio. ROM 0-110. Discharged from ortho follow up.
Pt 59F, k/c/o diabetis and hypertenshun. Sugars uncontrolled, FBS 212. Glycomet increased 500 to 1000 BD, added Jalra 50 mg OD (vildagliptin). BP 146/90. Review 1 month.
Telephone review. Mr S, COPD. Says breathing better since doubling his salbutamol nebs. Sats 94 percent on air. Cont tiotropium. Prednisolone course finished - stopped. Routine review 3 months.

Discharge: 68M admitted with UGI bleed from duodenal ulcer, H. pylori +ve. Endoscopic clipping done. Hb on discharge 9.6. Started on pantoprazole 40 mg BD x 8 wks, amoxicillin 1 g BD, clarithromycin 500 mg BD x 14 days. Aspirin withheld till GI review. Follow up GI clinic 2 weeks.
45 y/o lady, thyroid f/u. On thyroxine 75 mcg. TSH 0.1 (suppressed) - over-replaced. Cut down to 50 mcg daily. Recheck TSH in eight weeks. Wt 61.

OPD: 33M c/o acidity & bloating. H/o similar episodes. Not on any regular meds. Imp: dyspepsia. Rx: Rabeprazole 20mg before breakfast for 2 weeks + domperidone 10 mg TDS before meals. Avoid spicy food, alcohol. Review SOS.
BP one sixty over a hundred today, recheck after 10 min 154/96. Already on amlodipine 10. Added chlorthalidone 12.5 mg once daily. Na, K in 1 week. HR 74. Known hypertensive since 2015.
AF clinic: 74F, permanent atrial fib, CHA2DS2-VASc 5. On warfarin, INR labile. Switch warfarin to apixaban 5 mg twice a day. Continue bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD. HR 78 irregular. Creat 1.1. FU 3/12.
Pt with allergic rhinitis, sneezing ++ every morning. No wheeze. Started fluticasone nasal spray 2 puffs each nostril OD and cetirizine 10 mg at night. Review prn.

Sugar patient, 70 yrs, on insulin (premixed 30/70), 20 units morning 14 evening. Hypo episodes at 4am x3. Evening dose reduced to 10 units. HbA1c 6.4. Creatinine 1.6, eGFR 42. See after 2 wks with sugar charting.

ER: 26F, known asthmatic, acute exacerbation after URTI. RR 30, SpO2 90%, PEFR 40% predicted. Given salbutamol + ipratropium nebs x3, IV hydrocortisone 100 mg. Discharged after 6 hrs on prednisolone 40 mg OD x 5 days, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 2 puffs BD. Review GP 48 hrs.

Osteoporosis on DEXA (T score -3.1). 63F post-menopausal, prior wrist fracture. Start alendronate 70mg once a week, calcium 500 mg + vit D3 1000 IU daily. Vit D level 14 - start cholecalciferol 60,000 IU weekly x 8. Review 3 months.
Mareez ko 3 din se bukhar hai, khansi bhi. Temp 101 F. Chest clear. Viral fever lag raha hai. Paracetamol 650 SOS de diya. Paani zyada piyo. 3 din baad dikhana agar bukhar na utre.

Post CABG 3 mo. Doing well. Walks 2 km/day. BP 118/72, HR 60, LDL 62. Continue aspirin, atorvastatin 40, metoprolol 25 BD, ramipril 2.5 OD. Stop clopidogrel now (completed course). Next review 6 months.
Skin: 29M tinea cruris, itchy ring-shaped rash groin x 1 month. Using OTC steroid cream - told to stop. Start luliconazole cream BD x 3 wks + fluconazole 150 mg weekly x 4. Keep area dry. RV 3 weeks.
Pt is 50M with fatty liver on USG, ALT 88. BMI 32.5. Wt 98 kg, Ht 174 cm. Not diabetic (HbA1c 5.6). Advised wt loss 10%, no alcohol. Start vitamin E 400 IU OD. Repeat LFT 3 months.

Pt seen with daughter. 79M Alzheimer's dementia, now more agitated at night. No fever, urine NAD. Donepezil 10 mg continue. Add quetiapine 12.5 mg HS cautiously. Stop diphenhydramine (anticholinergic). Review 2 wks.
Suger after lunch 200, increased thrist, frequent urination, advice hb1ac test  reccomend to cardiologist
